Term coined by [[User:Mark Shoulson|Mark Shoulson]].
=Discussion=
*Face it, it's a more amusing term than [[Lojbanist|Lojbanist]].
*Possibly from Esperanto ''Loĵbanano''?
**No, not when I coined it.  I think I was reacting to the flap about about ''Lojbani'' sounding too eastern, and thought it was a funny-sounding name.  I don't remember thinking Esperanto at the time (but who knows?).
*Lojbanista!
*...or Lojbaneers.
*I still prefer {jbonobo}.
